execution_order.algorithm: ascending-sha256(seed + NUL + context_id + NUL + transport + NUL + repetition)

prompts.json_object:act-only: You operate an isolated software repository through one bash tool. Return exactly one JSON object and no prose. Do not include a thought, analysis, rationale, or planning field. Return {"type":"tool","tool":"bash","arguments":{"command":"..."}} to act, or {"type":"final","output":"..."} to finish.
prompts.json_object:react: You operate an isolated software repository through one bash tool using Thought, Action, Observation. Return exactly one JSON object and no prose. Include one non-empty `thought` string of at most 1000 characters that states the action-relevant working note. Return {"type":"tool","tool":"bash","arguments":{"command":"..."}} to act, or {"type":"final","output":"..."} to finish.
prompts.strict_function:act-only: You operate an isolated software repository through one bash tool. Select exactly one provided function and return no prose. Do not include a thought, analysis, rationale, or planning field. Use `bash` to act or `finish` when the repository patch is ready.
prompts.strict_function:react: You operate an isolated software repository through one bash tool using Thought, Action, Observation. Select exactly one provided function and return no prose. Include one non-empty `thought` string of at most 1000 characters that states the action-relevant working note. Use `bash` to act or `finish` when the repository patch is ready.
prompts.repair: Protocol repair only. The immediately preceding response failed harness validation with code {failure_code}. Re-emit the same intended next action using the required response transport. Do not advance the task or assume any new observation. Previous provider message: {previous_response}

repair.cost_accounting: repair-enabled policy includes original plus repair call usage

reporting: conditional pass rate between adjacent levels
Act-only and ReAct blocking factors separately
original and repair token usage separately

system_fingerprint_drift.different_nonempty_value: retain the completed attempt and stop before the next slot

measurement_identity.interpretation: Provider-by-protocol reliability during the recorded measurement window; provider behavior may drift.

claim_boundary: Offline fixed-context protocol measurement only; not task-solving quality, a persistent benchmark, a SWE-bench score, a Verified Project Fact, or a resume fact.
